subject: Code review: Changes requested for MOCK-HW-1-test

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The diff only updates the test expectation but does NOT address the prescribed root cause: getGreeting() still returns 'hello world'. The test fails (vitest exit code 1). The prescribed minimal fix is to change line 2 of src/hello.ts from `return 'hello world';` to `return 'hello dolly';`. Without this source change, the verification criterion ('a tester observes the text hello dolly rendered on the user-facing output') cannot be met — the application still outputs 'hello world'.
issues.suggestedFix: Change src/hello.ts line 2: `return 'hello dolly';` instead of `return 'hello world';`. The test change in hello.test.ts is correct but insufficient alone.

issues.description: Missing newline at end of file (diff shows `\ No newline at end of file`).
issues.suggestedFix: Add a trailing newline at end of src/hello.test.ts.
